customManagers.description: Keep biome.json $schema version in sync with @biomejs/biome package version.

packageRules.description: Group and automerge non-major dependency updates. CI must pass before merge.
Automerge Node.js patch/minor updates. Node is managed via .nvmrc (nodenv manager), not package.json, so matchDepTypes does not apply.
Automerge GitHub Actions patch/minor updates. Actions use the github-actions manager, not package.json depTypes.
Group Drizzle packages together. No automerge — migrations may be needed.
Group Cloudflare packages together. No automerge — wrangler and worker types often have behaviour changes.

Group Playwright npm packages and Docker image together and automerge. The container image in playwright-ct.yaml and npm packages are updated in the same PR, so a passing CI check confirms they're in sync.
